_meta.role: Embedded Software & Electronics Engineer (12-month placement, summer 2027)

summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY, with a B.E. in Electronics & Telecommunication. Built embedded C/C++ firmware on STM32 and Arduino microcontrollers (timer-triggered ADC, interrupt-driven I2C and UART drivers) and designed and fabricated custom EAGLE PCBs for competition robots. Debugged hardware and software integration failures across sensors, servos and Jetson-class controllers, including 11 resolved in an MS capstone.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE (schematic capture and PCB layout) for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.
Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and AI/ML integration end-to-end.
Organized 10+ exhibitions and technical workshops covering Arduino, PCB design, and SolidWorks.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real-time data acquisition and experimental visualization in a laboratory environment.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Built Cortex-M4 temperature monitoring firmware in embedded C with timer-synchronized sensing and real-time display; achieved 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at a deterministic 1 Hz update rate.
Implemented timer-triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt-driven sample capture, and a low-level I2C driver.
Programmed peripherals directly in bare-metal C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1); verified in Proteus.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Debugged and resolved 11 hardware and software integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials).
Integrated dual VL53L0X ToF sensors (camera range-gate + gripper-ToF-triggered close at 25 mm) over a TCA9548A I2C mux for contact-aware grasping.
Implemented two-link IK on Arduino in C++; drove five servos with range-gated contact detection.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Implemented multi-servo PWM control on STM32 with interrupt-driven UART commands from a Jetson running YOLOv8, with user override.
Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance visualization.
